title: Legion squad
description: Every squad-wide setting, in one file: .legion/legion.json. Replaces the older .legion/squad and .legion/ao files. Legion checks this file with `legion check`, and before starting any position.

operatorSettings.description: The same keys as an operator.json (see operator.schema.json).

squad.description: The squad's name. Every position is addressed as <squad>-<position>, so it must be unique among squads running on this machine.

configMode.description: layered: every session also loads your own ~/.claude config. isolated: it doesn't (--setting-sources project,local). An operator's own configMode overrides this.

model.description: Default Claude model for every session (opus, sonnet, haiku or a full model id). Blank uses claude's own default. An operator's own model overrides this.

addDirs.description: Absolute paths of extra folders or repos every session may open, beyond the project, passed as --add-dir. Replaces the old ao file. Paths that differ per machine go in the git-ignored .legion/legion.local.json ({"addDirs": [...]}), which Legion adds to these.

defaults.description: Settings every operator (not commander) starts with. An operator's own operator.json goes on top: its allowedTools and disallowedTools are added to these, and any other key it sets replaces the default.

ownFolder.description: A path inside the project, containing {operator}, like "notes/{operator}". Each operator is blocked from editing every other operator's folder, so each writes only in its own. Copies share their operator's folder; commander isn't blocked.

commander.description: Commander's own settings: the operator.json keys except scale, plus checkEvery. An operators/commander/operator.json still goes on top.

checkEvery.description: How often commander checks the squad and gives idle operators work that doesn't wait on anyone, like "1m". Leave it out for no regular check.
